item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Night Market Event Pack

turns.text: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read.

item.tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Lantern Night Market; 18 September 2027; 6–10 PM; Riverside Yard; Free entry. Include all five on every asset.
answer_sheet.Deliverables and dimensions: One 4:5 poster image, one 9:16 story image and one 9:16 reel.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm lantern imagery with midnight blue and gold; the three assets should visibly belong together.
answer_sheet.Music, voice and animation: Your call; no voiceover is needed.
answer_sheet.Additional copy or logo: No logo or additional event details are needed.

must_haves: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.

turns.text: Could you make me a matching event pack with a poster, a vertical story image and a vertical reel that all look like they belong together? I’m excited about this event, and having the visuals together will make it feel a bit more real to me. The poster should be 4:5 and the reel should be 10 seconds long, and all three need to say Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. For the look, please use warm lanterns with midnight blue and gold. I always worry that I’ll get caught up in how pretty something looks and forget whether people can actually read it. Please keep the reel text easy to read.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—the midnight blue and gold with warm lanterns will give the set a lovely shared look. I’ll prioritize strong contrast and a calm text layout so the details stay easy to read, especially in the reel.

Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly? I have these five lines from your message—please confirm:
> Lantern Night Market  
> 18 September 2027  
> 6–10 PM  
> Riverside Yard  
> Free entry

Should the reel be silent or include music?
dialog.why: It asks the user to confirm the exact wording and choose whether the reel should be silent or include music, then waits for their response.
dialog.user: Yes, those are exactly the five lines—please include all five on every asset. Music is your call, and no voiceover is needed. The story and reel should both be 9:16, and there’s no logo or additional event copy to add. I’m especially keen for the three pieces to visibly belong together without making the reel text hard to read.

turns.agent:
The design direction is ready, but **Magic Hour refused the first image generation because the connected account has insufficient credits**. No assets were created or credits spent.

For the matching set, I’d use:
- **4:5 poster and 9:16 story:** warm gold lanterns framing a midnight-blue center, with large, high-contrast cream-and-gold lettering.
- **10-second 9:16 reel:** the same composition, with all five lines visible throughout—no scrolling or text transitions. Only the lantern glow would move gently, with soft instrumental music and no voiceover.

Every piece would include your exact five lines, with no extra copy or logo.

Once credits are available, I can continue with the pack.

style.prompt:
Design an elegant, extremely legible event story artwork, vertical 9:16. Midnight blue flat central field, warm glowing golden paper lanterns elegantly framing top corners and sides, delicate gold linework, subtle silhouettes of riverside market stalls confined to bottom 15 percent. Sophisticated editorial event design, rich midnight blue and gold palette, warm welcoming atmosphere. Centered generous clean negative space for five exact lines of text. Render ONLY these five lines, faithfully spelled, no slash separators:
Lantern Night Market
18 September 2027
6–10 PM
Riverside Yard
Free entry
The first line is the large gold serif headline, on one line if possible; other lines use very clear large cream typography with generous spacing. Gold thin border with ample interior margin. All text safely inside the central 65 percent of width and middle 60 percent of height, large enough for phone reading. Strong solid dark blue behind all lettering, no lights crossing letters. No logo, no additional words. Prioritize correct copy and readability over ornament.
